sampling.method: Reservoir sample of 5000 unsupported canonical roots in ascending key order, using LCG 1664525/1013904223 modulo 2^32
sampling.limitations: Does not estimate longer cycles. Motif ranking from this small number of random hits is tentative. Targeted examples are not included in the estimator.
sampling.comparisonNote: The new supported declaration removes one unsupported D4 root. Rebuilding the seeded reservoir after excluding that root changes sample membership. Do not interpret the point-estimate change from the preceding report as a population increase.

supportedCheck.scope: All supported post-White census placements. Loops may include unsupported positions. Supplied support-loss examples include a verified preferred setup move; raw loss-motif counts can include sources without a preferred predecessor.
